description: Why does HEY say a project is Shipping, Dormant or Still Building, or show a figure? The value, FACT, DERIVED or UNKNOWN, the rule and version, the winning source, the inputs, the lineage and the evidence ids. Omit fact to list what can be explained; source.counted takes a source id. build.change explains one change (event=<ledger id>, or the latest): its stage, who reported it, any exact release↔deployment link, what HEY does not know.

event.description: With fact=build.change: a change-ledger id; omit for the latest.

name: explain_fact
title: Explain a fact
